prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet library reading room. On the left, a woman in a blue cardigan sits on a wooden chair, her posture relaxed yet attentive. Next to her, a small potted fern rests on the floor, its leaves detailed with fine graphite lines. In the center, a tall oak bookshelf stands firm, filled with spines of varying heights. A man in a red scarf leans against this shelf, holding an open hardcover book with both hands. To his right, a child in a yellow shirt points at a specific illustration within the pages, drawing the man's gaze downward toward the image. Perched atop the shelf is a sleepy orange cat, curled into a tight ball, ignoring the activity below. Near the foreground, a vintage brass lamp casts a soft glow, its base polished and reflective. A stack of three thick encyclopedias lies next to the lamp, slightly askew. In the background, a librarian with glasses looks at a computer screen, typing slowly. Behind her, a large window reveals faint outlines of trees outside. A brown leather satchel hangs from the back of an empty chair near the window. There is no electronic tablet visible anywhere in the room. There is no coffee cup or beverage container present on any surface. The interaction between the child and the man creates a focal point of shared curiosity, while the woman in the blue cardigan remains absorbed in her own thoughts. The orange cat remains undisturbed by the pointing finger below. The potted fern adds a touch of organic texture against the rigid lines of the furniture. The brass lamp provides a warm contrast to the cool tones of the sketch. The encyclopedias suggest heavy research, while the open book implies leisurely reading. The librarian continues her work unnoticed by the patrons. The window frames the exterior world without letting it intrude. The satchel waits patiently for its owner. The scene balances stillness with subtle human connection through gesture and proximity.
